findings.detail: Core has 42 occurrences of 账户 and 0 of 账号, including mobile.setup.account 'Radient账户：{identity}（凭据{id}）' and the whole relay.account_policy screen. The same wave uses 账号 in mobile.account_routing, and the group-A audit independently grades that term MAJOR (AR-01). One account concept needs one word; 账户下 is also the natural locative for computers under an account. A wave decision to use 账号 must be applied to account_routing too, not split.
